name: Change of Status to F-2 (COS to F-2, Form I-539)
name_pt: Mudança de Status para F-2 (COS para F-2, Formulário I-539)
name_es: Cambio de Estatus a F-2 (COS a F-2, Formulario I-539)

phases.name: Document Collection & Review
documents: Previous USCIS receipts or approval (if any)
Sponsor ID / personal information / signed letter (if applicable)
Principal student's (F-1) current I-94, passport, visa, receipt/approval, SEVIS payment
DSO letter about current progress at school
documents_pt: Recibos ou aprovações anteriores da USCIS (se houver)
Comprovante de endereço atual nos EUA
Identidade/informações do patrocinador, carta assinada (se aplicável)
Diploma e histórico do ensino médio
I-94, passaporte, visto, recibo/aprovação, comprovante SEVIS do estudante principal (F-1)
I-20 (novo e inicial) do estudante principal
Carta do DSO sobre progresso atual na escola
documents_es: Recibos o aprobaciones anteriores de USCIS (si los hay)
Comprobante de domicilio actual en EE. UU.
Identificación/información del patrocinador, carta firmada (si aplica)
I-94, pasaporte, visa, recibo/aprobación, comprobante de pago SEVIS del estudiante principal (F-1)
I-20 (nuevo e inicial) del estudiante principal
Carta del DSO sobre el progreso actual en la escuela
steps: Gather proof of ties to home country (family, residence, employment, academic history)

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Draft supporting letters: explanation (reason for COS) + B-2 photos, address, employer, sponsor

pricing.notes: No separately-priced F-2 line exists in the contract — F-2 only ever appears as a dependent add-on (+$25/dependent) under the F-1 (language school) line. Pricing mirrors cos_to_f1's language-school tier; re-check with the team before quoting a standalone F-2 case.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: Complete checklist of documents and information
Google Drive link for document uploads
Review and organization of supporting documents
Preparation of the Change of Status Cover Letter, based on 18 years of experience
Recommendation of two language schools based on location, schedule, and cost
plus_includes: Translation of the address letter, sponsor/sponsorship letter, and employer letter
Client pays only the USCIS filing fee
$15 convenience fee waived when the SAES card is used to pay SEVIS, USCIS, or school fees
plus_excludes: School fees (registration, enrollment, change of status)
